summary: Documentation audit implementation addresses all 24 identified issues (C1-C4, H1-H10, M1-M4, L1) across 12 markdown files with 214 insertions and 50 deletions. All critical and high-severity issues are resolved correctly: CLI commands updated in CHANGELOG (C3/C4), host_config.py removed from config/README (C1), SlackConfig example replaced with GatewayConfig (C2), gateway endpoints and source files documented (H1/H2), sandbox modules and symlinks listed (H3/H4/H5), shared package documentation expanded (H6/H7), action README completed (H8), stale prompt builder references removed (H9), ADR-Declarative-Setup-Architecture status corrected to partial (H10). Cross-document consistency verified for ports, branch naming, and inter-document links. Two minor gaps noted but not blocking: (1) validator.py missing from egg_contracts module listing in shared/README.md (1 of 23 modules), (2) CHANGELOG references egg-config as a separate utility but no binary entry point exists (the Python CLI module shared/egg_config/cli.py exists but is not wired as a console_scripts entry point).
